title: Malicious code in tailwind-animate-engine (npm)
description: The tailwind-animate-engine npm package contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a separate, uncompromised machine. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software or control established by the attacker.
